```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Safe summary functions
# -----------------------------

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(x)
}

safe_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) NA_real_ else sd(x)
}

safe_min <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else min(x)
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else max(x)
}


# -----------------------------
# 1. Average measurements per ID
# -----------------------------

data_average_per_ID <- data %>%
  group_by(Age, Group, ID) %>%
  summarise(
    RBPMS_RGCs_Avg = safe_mean(`RBPMS+`),
    GFP_RBPMS_RGCs_Avg = safe_mean(`GFP+ RBPMS+`),
    tdtom_RBPMS_RGCs_Avg = safe_mean(`tdtom+RBPMS+`),
    GFP_RGCs_Avg = safe_mean(GFP_RGCs),
    tdTomato_RGCs_Avg = safe_mean(tdTomato_RGCs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(data_average_per_ID)


# -----------------------------
# 2. Summary by Age and Group
#    Statistics are calculated
#    across IDs
# -----------------------------

data_average_by_group <- data_average_per_ID %>%
  group_by(Age, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        RBPMS_RGCs_Avg,
        GFP_RBPMS_RGCs_Avg,
        tdtom_RBPMS_RGCs_Avg,
        GFP_RGCs_Avg,
        tdTomato_RGCs_Avg
      ),
      list(
        N = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
        Mean = ~ safe_mean(.x),
        SD = ~ safe_sd(.x),
        Min = ~ safe_min(.x),
        Max = ~ safe_max(.x)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(data_average_by_group)


# -----------------------------
# 3. Summary by Age only
#    Statistics are calculated
#    directly across IDs
# -----------------------------

data_summary_by_age <- data_average_per_ID %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        RBPMS_RGCs_Avg,
        GFP_RBPMS_RGCs_Avg,
        tdtom_RBPMS_RGCs_Avg,
        GFP_RGCs_Avg,
        tdTomato_RGCs_Avg
      ),
      list(
        N = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
        Mean = ~ safe_mean(.x),
        SD = ~ safe_sd(.x),
        Min = ~ safe_min(.x),
        Max = ~ safe_max(.x)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(data_summary_by_age)
```

Make a plot for the percentage of tdTomato+ RGCs
```{r}
# 1. Pivot the data_long dataset to long format with both GFP and tdTomato means
data_long <- data_average_by_n %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("GFP_RGCs_Avg_Mean", "tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_Mean"),
    names_to = "Variable", 
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# 2. Calculate SD for both GFP and tdTomato RGCs (already done in data_sd_by_age)
data_sd_by_age <- data_average_per_ID %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    GFP_RGCs_Avg_Mean = mean(GFP_RGCs_Avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    GFP_RGCs_Avg_SD = sd(GFP_RGCs_Avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_Mean = mean(tdTomato_RGCs_Avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_SD = sd(tdTomato_RGCs_Avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"  # Drop grouping after summarizing
  )

# 3. Merge the long data and SD data by Age (note: check if column names match)
data_long_with_errorbars <- data_long %>%
  left_join(data_sd_by_age, by = "Age")

# Check the column names of the merged dataset to ensure SD columns exist
print(colnames(data_long_with_errorbars))

# 4. Create SD_value column for each variable based on the "Variable" column
data_long_with_errorbars <- data_long_with_errorbars %>%
  mutate(
    SD_value = case_when(
      Variable == "GFP_RGCs_Avg_Mean" ~ GFP_RGCs_Avg_SD.y,  # Assign GFP SD for GFP variable
      Variable == "tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_Mean" ~ tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_SD.y,  # Assign tdTomato SD for tdTomato variable
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # In case something else comes up (it shouldn't)
    )
  )

# View the result to make sure the SD_value column is correctly created
print(data_long_with_errorbars)


# Define colors for the variables
bar_colors <- c("GFP_RGCs_Avg_Mean" = "#808080",  # light green for GFP
                "tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_Mean" = "#555555")  # tomato red for tdTomato

  
   
# Summarize the data to get the mean and SD value for each combination of Age and Variable
data_summary <- data_long_with_errorbars %>%
  group_by(Age, Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_value = mean(SD_value, na.rm = TRUE),  # Use SD_value column here for each group
    .groups = "drop"
  )

GFP_tdtomato_rgc_plot <- 
  ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = Age, y = Mean_Value, fill = Variable, color = Variable)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.8,
    size = 3  
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = bar_colors,
    labels = c(
      expression(paste("GFP+ RGCs that transiently expressed ", italic("Mafb"))),
      expression(paste("mCherry+ RGCs that currently express ", italic("Mafb")))
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = bar_colors) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = Mean_Value - SD_value,
      ymax = Mean_Value + SD_value
    ),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = data_long_with_errorbars,
    aes(x = Age, y = Value, fill = Variable),
    shape = 21,
    size = 8,
    stroke = 2,
     color = "black",
    alpha = 0.8,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.3,
      jitter.height = 0.6,
      dodge.width = 0.9
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = "% colocalization with RBPMS"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),             # Tick thickness
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) 

# Display the plot
GFP_tdtomato_rgc_plot




#save file to whatever you set as your working directory
ggsave(filename = "20250619_P0-P56_GFP_tdTomato_RGCs_plot.pdf", plot = GFP_tdtomato_rgc_plot, device = pdf, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
data_long_with_errorbars$Age <- factor(
  data_long_with_errorbars$Age,
  levels = c("P0-P1", "P28", "P56-P58")
)

gfp_data <- data_long_with_errorbars %>%
  filter(Variable == "GFP_RGCs_Avg_Mean")

tdtomato_data <- data_long_with_errorbars %>%
  filter(Variable == "tdTomato_RGCs_Avg_Mean")

anova_gfp <- aov(Value ~ Age, data = gfp_data)
anova_tdtomato <- aov(Value ~ Age, data = tdtomato_data)

# View results
summary(anova_gfp)
summary(anova_tdtomato)

# Only run if ANOVA p < 0.05
TukeyHSD(anova_gfp)
TukeyHSD(anova_tdtomato)
```
